title: Area-code shard C pass 28 — 737 / 740 / 743

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public professional actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 737, 740, and 743?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public professional-role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling. X and Reddit discovery did not depend on official APIs.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, membership, public role, or event participation.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: Austin Mutual Aid was re-verified and reused from the prior 512 overlay pass. ATX Free Fridge Project and Austin Food Not Bombs are new canonical org identities. Austin FNB remains anarchist-associated through the Food Not Bombs family; no individual ideology inferred.

Food Not Bombs Athens was already canonical from the Ohio FNB expansion and is reused based on current Ohio University listing. United Campus Ministry is new, directly publishes a 740 number, and first-party material directly identifies Ari Faber as Executive Director.

Food Not Bombs Greensboro was already canonical under the 336 overlay family and is reused. Greensboro Mutual Aid and etc. are new canonical org identities; etc. self-describes as a decentralized DIY collective rooted in mutual-aid principles and exposes a public collective Discord.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-professional-role enumeration pass

summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public professional-role enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 737, 740, and 743.
